title: 06 Plumpot: playful fintech hero
strengths: Copy is specific and honest: 'Get paid for chores, split the pizza, watch your jars fill. Parents see the big picture, never every move.'
The coin recipe (elliptical face, darker knurled edge, one highlight) and the card with chip, contactless mark and 'MAYA R.' are drawn consistently
Spacing is tidy and the pill nav with an active tab is clean
slop_signals: A large pastel gradient circle (pink to lavender to mint) behind the card, there only to be a backdrop
Four four-point sparkles scattered around the headline and the card
'New  Savings jars that fill themselves' pill badge above the headline
Headline with 'big plans.' in a pink highlight block, two buttons underneath, then three check-mark reassurances: the full template stack in order
A tilted card with three floating UI cards at different angles and shadows (Festival ticket 64%, £5.00 dog walking, Sneaker fund), plus five coins scattered for depth
A round 'AGES 13-17 · NO FEES' rotating-text sticker in the bottom corner
fixes: Pick one object and make it real: the card standing on something physical (a desk, a lunch tray) or one phone screen, as Revolut <18 and UGLYCASH do; cut the gradient circle, sparkles, sticker and most coins
Remove the pill badge, the highlight block and the check row; one button
If a second element is needed, show one jar (a savings goal) as part of the product, not as a floating card
Let the headline be smaller so the product carries the page; Fredoka at this size plus the highlight reads as a toy, not a bank

references.what: Teen account hero: the card standing on a rendered desk with a notebook and pencil, uppercase headline, one button; no floating UI, no badge, no sparkles
Two cards and two squiggles on white, one button; playful with four objects, not fourteen
Huge headline and one phone, nothing else; scale contrast does the fun
Rendered coins with real edge detail and lighting; ours follow the recipe but flatter, and there are too many
